purpose: Preparation-only bounded read-only Meta grant qualification; no provider run authorized by this artifact.

runtimeArtifact.inspection: targeted docker.exe inspect format allowlist plus node crypto hash of the one named runtime file; no Config.Env, mounts, logs, or other runtime files inspected

inputProtocol.transport: Host launcher streams the helper source and only the three named local values over docker exec stdin; inside the exact runtime container it reads the four named inherited base keys individually and never enumerates process.env. No private argument, persisted payload, .env.testing copy/hash/dump, or Config.Env inspection.
inputProtocol.privateLocalKeys: Launcher first validates a non-secret consumed-once CP82 live GO receipt, then requires exact operator confirmation, then streams .env.testing line by line and retains only these three names; never read_text/bulk dotenv load or print the file.
inputProtocol.baseValues: Use only the four named inherited process values; never enumerate or dump environment/configuration.

launcher.preflightBeforePrivateRead: rehash helper, targeted docker inspect of id/image/state/project/service/owner only, and hash exactly the pinned runtime adapter file
launcher.timeout: One monotonic 40-second budget starts at execute entry and is shared by GO/confirmation, runtime attestation, bounded named-key scan, and invoke. Before docker.exe spawn, the launcher converts the remaining budget to one absolute UTC epoch deadline capped at 35 seconds from spawn request; the remote runner rejects an already-expired deadline and arms its self-exit timer only for the deadline remainder. Host kills docker.exe at the original monotonic deadline. Raw stderr is discarded and arbitrary stdout is never forwarded.
launcher.replayProtection: Exact GO receipt is claimed with atomic O_CREAT|O_EXCL receipt-id marker before private input read; replay and concurrent duplicate claims reject.
launcher.helperTransport: Helper bytes are read once, SHA-256 checked, and the same bytes are placed in stdin payload; no private argv or persisted payload.

callContract.providerBudget: at most 3 fixed graph.facebook.com v26.0 GETs, 10 seconds each; debug grant plus at most 2 fixed-WABA phone pages, page size 100; no retry, redirect, writes, other method, or other WABA

offlineVerification.adapter: actual pinned compiled MetaHttpClient with fake global.fetch responses; no live network
offlineVerification.coverage: success, app/scope/granular-target rejection, malformed and absent phone, two-page cap, 10-second AbortSignal, transport timeout, error privacy, input/output allowlists

requiredBeforeUse: operator confirmation of three local values

offlineSyntaxVerification.nodeRunner: passed via node Function parse in pinned runtime container; no execution/network
offlineSyntaxVerification.python: passed before v4-only test changes; launcher offline suite imports/parses updated launcher successfully
